title: Greek Chicken and Quinoa Stuffed Peppers
intro: This satisfying lunch is perfect for a busy workday. Using the microwave to steam the bell peppers turns a weekend favorite into a fast, desk-friendly meal that provides steady afternoon energy.

ingredients.name: Shredded skinless rotisserie chicken breast
ingredients.canonical_name: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

ingredients.name: Cherry tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

instructions: Place the bell pepper halves cut-side down in a microwave-safe dish with water. Cover with a microwave-safe lid and microwave on high for 4 to 6 minutes.
Remove the dish from the microwave and drain any excess water. Flip the peppers cut-side up to cool.
Whisk the extra-virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and dried oregano together in a mixing bowl.
Add the shredded chicken, cooked quinoa, cherry tomatoes, baby spinach, and kalamata olives to the bowl. Toss the ingredients together until the spinach softens and the mixture is coated.
Spoon the chicken and quinoa filling into the steamed bell pepper halves.
Top each stuffed pepper with the crumbled feta cheese.
Serve the stuffed peppers immediately or let them cool entirely to pack in airtight containers.
variation: Swap the chicken for small, untreated cooked shrimp.
conservation: Keeps 2-3 days refrigerated; enjoy cold or gently heated.
